provenance.registry_note: The global-versus-domestic dislocation gauge. Widens on supply shocks abroad, US export bottlenecks, or Cushing storage builds.

derivation.note: Positive means waterborne global crude is dearer than landlocked US crude, which is the normal state. A widening spread usually signals a supply shock or shipping risk abroad rather than anything happening in the US. A collapsing or negative spread signals a US glut or an export bottleneck.

move.detail: $-0.30. Bigger in magnitude than 36% of the 2162 moves since 2018-01-03. The typical move is $0.80; this is 0.1 sigma.
